page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a running head at the top; a few faint marks in the left margin, not printed text; a catchword-like word "ria" at lower right, set off after the last line.

main_text.p: conditiones circumferunt hi, quorum peregrinationem comprobat Deus. At uestri peregrini has pietatis conditiones nusquam oftendunt, expertus enim satis satisque no ui. E fexcentis uix unum proferas, qui Dei mandata calleat, qui oratio nem Dominicam aut fidei symbolu recte pronunciet: plus quam friuola sunt quae plurimos ad peregrinatio nem adducunt, ueluti corporis salu britas, carnalis amicitia, prosperitas, luxus, petulantia, prodigalitas, et le nones, at quid tandem hi post tam gra ues impensas, & membra defatiga ta reperiunt, nisi offa mortuorum, ac mutas imagines? Haec uanissima esse quis non uidet, qui ullum diuini spiritus gustu sapit? Quod si quid hinc lucelli prouenit, (prouenit autem permultum) id uniuersum, uel in au uaros sacerdotes, uel in meretrices deciditur, ut fileamus interim neglectas domi familias, quibus necessaria

page.notes: Printed text is in a single column of body type. The word "ria" at the lower right is the continuation of the hyphenated word "necessaria" and is treated as catchword. Some marks in the left margin are show-through or stains and are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "satisque", "lucelli", "uanissima" and "uaros" are copied as they appear on the scan.
